edits.new:
Then the answer carries the error envelope

  Scenario: AC7 Activity retry and timeout (legacy none)
    Given the rwb-asset build is in SIT with its fakes
    When the AssetDisposalWorkflow activity is retried or times out
    Then no duplicate transfer record, asset_sale row or instruction is written

  Scenario: AC8 A consumed call fails or does not answer (legacy none)
    Given the rwb-asset build is in SIT with its fakes
    When a consumed contract call fails or does not answer
    Then nothing changes, no instruction is sent and the case does not move

  Scenario: AC9 A disallowed status change is refused (legacy none)
    Given the rwb-asset build is in SIT with its fakes
    When a status change the model does not allow is requested
    Then the change is refused and nothing changes
